source_pool_format: optimization/columns.jsonl beside completion.result_path; exclude artificials; preserve full ordered records

physics.charging_control: constant adjustable power within original graph charge window
physics.zero_actual_energy: idle station visit, excluded active start count
physics.terminal_energy: aggregate minimum common to both arms

model.fleet: sum selectors <= k, in BOTH stages
model.terminal: sum route terminal_energy_kwh * selector >= original aggregate target
model.stage2: minimize sum (route cost - 100000) * selector; retain fleet <= stage1 incumbent <= k
model.initialization: cold reconstructed saved-pool MIP, no added routes or borrowed incumbent; same initializer across seeds
model.proof_scope: saved-pool only; reconstruction is a new search, not tree continuation

reporting.charging_cost_at_matched_fleet: numeric only if physical dispatch validated and selected fleet == k; otherwise null with reason
reporting.fewer_than_k: report fleet improvement separately; not like-for-like charging comparison
reporting.no_incumbent: unknown feasibility unless solver proves infeasible; never label zero cost
reporting.seeds: publish all seeds and bounds; do not select only best outcomes
reporting.tariff_se3: raw and derived scientific results remain internal

resources_proposed.concurrency_policy: up to50 independent cases after user approval; measured load/resource reasons for any reduction

implementation_required: Dedicated MIP-only loader for terminal-energy/minimum-charge record schema, deterministic ordered-pool hash, explicit Seed, independent selected-schedule validation, native Gurobi tests. Legacy871 run_exact_pool_mip.py is not assumed compatible.

sequencing.seed0: afterok original item10 CG job; that job includes its original two-stage MIP, so dependency waits for the whole job
sequencing.seeds1_2: submit only after a valid seed0 endpoint fails to find a physically valid fleet<=k and feasibility remains unresolved; require afterok seed0 when submitted
sequencing.do_not_repeat: validated fleet<=k, proved pool infeasibility, invalid output or infrastructure failure; these require no more seeds or separate diagnosis
sequencing.authorization: PLAN ONLY; no submission authorized by endpoint gate alone

cases.release_gate: action2 submission is still not authorized; tested runner and frozen source required; seed0 afterok sourceCG; seeds1/2 only on audited unresolved seed0 miss
